'''V33-1XP''' was the designation of an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] jettisoned from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] [[Razor (CR90 corvette)|''Razor'']] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]] to whisk away the stolen [[Death Star II plans|plans]] to the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] from pursuing [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces safely into the hands of [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]].
